---
title: "Examples"
subtitle: "The narrow-screen table of contents, on a page and in a project."
description: "How the table of contents button looks and behaves on a single page, a website and a book."
---

This site uses the extension.
Make this window narrower than 768 pixels, the default `md` breakpoint of the theme, or open the page on a phone, to see the button at the bottom of the page.
The configuration is in the `_quarto.yml` file of the site:

```yaml
filters:
  - local/mobile-toc
```

On your own project, the filter name is `mobile-toc`.

## A single page

The smallest setup is a page with a table of contents and the filter in its front matter.

```yaml
---
title: "My report"
format: html
toc: true
filters:
  - mobile-toc
---
```

Select the button to open the sheet.
The current section is highlighted, and it follows the page as you scroll.
Press `Esc`, select the close button, or select outside the sheet to close it.

## A website and a book

For a website or a book, add the filter once in `_quarto.yml`:

```yaml
filters:
  - mobile-toc

format:
  html:
    toc: true
```

Every page that has a table of contents then gets the button.
On a website, the "back to top" button of Quarto moves above the button when both show.
On a book, the button follows the table of contents of each chapter.

## A custom title and close label

Set `toc-title` to change the text of the button.
Set the `language` key `mobile-toc-close` to change the close label:

```yaml
toc-title: "Sur cette page"
language:
  mobile-toc-close: "Fermer"
```

## Colours and position

Set the custom properties in your own stylesheet.
This example sets a brand colour for the current section, and puts the button 3 rem from the bottom edge:

```{.css filename="custom.css"}
:root {
  --mobile-toc-accent: #b3261e;
  --mobile-toc-active-bg: #fbe9e7;
  --mobile-toc-inset-block: 3rem;
}
```

The repository ships a short, standalone starting point you can copy: [`example.qmd`](https://github.com/mcanouil/quarto-mobile-toc/blob/main/example.qmd).
